domain_ports_inventory.limitation: Protocol classes named *Port under domain/ports only

port_adapter_factory_coverage.limitation: explicit TRACKED_PORTS / core_active_ports; not the R07 universe

coverage.behavioral_conformance_definition: VERIFIED rows / universe. Exclusions do not shrink this denominator.
coverage.classified_definition: rows whose classification is not unresolved / universe
coverage.owner_definition: rows with semantic, composition, and lifecycle owners other than unassigned-tracking / universe. Tracking responsibility is not ownership.

definitions.universe: classes in candidate roots, token-named classes, structural Protocol matches, composition factory/register functions, provider-variant tuples, and composition/infrastructure/domain-port __getattr__ seams
definitions.verdict_rule: bounded_structural_registration_architecture_assert: complete structural or explicit port match, composition/package/runtime reachability, and an architecture test function that both names the symbol and contains assert. This is not exhaustive semantic conformance.
